cards.target: Partageons le gâteau équitablement.
cards.english: Let's share the cake fairly.

cards.target: Ayez confiance en vous !
cards.english: Have confidence in yourselves!

cards.target: Mettons-nous d'accord avant la réunion.
cards.english: Let's agree before the meeting.

cards.target: Les prix augmenteront en janvier.
cards.english: Prices will increase in January.

cards.target: Il va pleuvoir cet après-midi.
cards.english: It's going to rain this afternoon.

cards.target: Pensons à l'avenir et préparons-nous.
cards.english: Let's think about the future and prepare ourselves.

cards.target: Profite bien de tes vacances !
cards.english: Enjoy your vacation!

cards.target: Dis-moi ce qui ne va pas.
cards.english: Tell me what's wrong.

cards.target: Tu as reçu mon message ?
cards.english: Did you receive my message?

cards.target: J'ai écrit un message de remerciement.
cards.english: I wrote a thank-you message.

cards.target: Fais tes devoirs avant de jouer.
cards.english: Do your homework before playing.

cards.target: N'aie pas peur, je suis là.
cards.english: Don't be afraid, I'm here.

cards.target: Ne te compare pas aux autres.
cards.english: Don't compare yourself to others.

cards.target: Ne te plains pas et agis.
cards.english: Don't complain and take action.

cards.target: Tu devrais te reposer un peu.
cards.english: You should rest a little.

cards.target: Voyons ce que nous pouvons faire.
cards.english: Let's see what we can do.

cards.target: Rangez vos affaires avant de partir.
cards.english: Put away your things before leaving.

cards.target: Soyons positifs et trouvons des solutions.
cards.english: Let's be positive and find solutions.

cards.target: Auriez-vous l'heure, s'il vous plaît ?
cards.english: Could you tell me the time, please?

cards.target: Prends ton parapluie, il va pleuvoir.
cards.english: Take your umbrella, it's going to rain.

cards.target: Le professeur expliquera la leçon demain.
cards.english: The teacher will explain the lesson tomorrow.

cards.target: Je paierai l'addition, c'est mon tour.
cards.english: I'll pay the bill, it's my turn.

cards.target: Écoute-moi quand je te parle !
cards.english: Listen to me when I'm talking to you!

cards.target: Cet hiver, il neigera probablement beaucoup.
cards.english: This winter, it will probably snow a lot.

cards.target: Ne cours pas dans les couloirs !
cards.english: Don't run in the hallways!

cards.target: Ne vous arrêtez pas, continuez tout droit.
cards.english: Don't stop, keep going straight.

cards.target: Inscrivez-vous en ligne avant la date limite.
cards.english: Register online before the deadline.

cards.target: Ne sois pas si dur avec toi-même.
cards.english: Don't be so hard on yourself.

cards.target: Le bus passera dans un quart d'heure.
cards.english: The bus will arrive in fifteen minutes.

cards.target: Donne-moi la main pour traverser la rue.
cards.english: Give me your hand to cross the street.

cards.target: Calmez-vous et expliquez-moi ce qui s'est passé.
cards.english: Calm down and explain to me what happened.

cards.target: Monte dans la voiture, on est pressés.
cards.english: Get in the car, we're in a hurry.

cards.target: Le médecin vous recevra dans une heure.
cards.english: The doctor will see you in an hour.

cards.target: Je t'appellerai dès que j'arrive à l'aéroport.
cards.english: I'll call you as soon as I arrive at the airport.

cards.target: Ne touche pas à ça, c'est fragile !
cards.english: Don't touch that, it's fragile!

cards.target: Nettoyez votre espace de travail avant de partir.
cards.english: Clean your workspace before leaving.

cards.target: Ne te décourage pas, tu vas y arriver.
cards.english: Don't give up, you'll get there.

cards.target: Tu ne devrais pas manger autant de sucre.
cards.english: You shouldn't eat so much sugar.

cards.target: Quand nous aurons économisé assez d'argent, nous voyagerons.
cards.english: When we've saved enough money, we'll travel.

cards.target: Il devrait faire plus attention à sa santé.
cards.english: He should pay more attention to his health.

cards.target: Écris ton nom en haut de la page.
cards.english: Write your name at the top of the page.

cards.target: On va acheter un nouveau canapé ce week-end.
cards.english: We're going to buy a new sofa this weekend.

cards.target: Elles vont passer la soirée chez des amis.
cards.english: They're going to spend the evening at friends' house.

cards.target: Ils vont renouveler leur passeport avant le voyage.
cards.english: They're going to renew their passport before the trip.

cards.target: Si vous veniez samedi, nous pourrions dîner ensemble.
cards.english: If you came on Saturday, we could have dinner together.

cards.target: Je souhaiterais obtenir plus d'informations sur ce programme.
cards.english: I would like to get more information about this program.

cards.target: Tu auras besoin de ton passeport pour ce voyage.
cards.english: You'll need your passport for this trip.

cards.target: Si tu changeais de travail, tu serais plus heureux.
cards.english: If you changed jobs, you would be happier.

cards.target: Si je savais la réponse, je te la dirais.
cards.english: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.

cards.target: Je vais lui offrir un livre pour son anniversaire.
cards.english: I'm going to give him a book for his birthday.

cards.target: La nouvelle loi entrera en vigueur le premier janvier.
cards.english: The new law will come into effect on January first.

cards.target: Nous allons célébrer notre anniversaire de mariage au restaurant.
cards.english: We're going to celebrate our wedding anniversary at the restaurant.

cards.target: Ne me dis pas que tu as encore oublié !
cards.english: Don't tell me you forgot again!

cards.target: N'hésite pas à me contacter si tu as des questions.
cards.english: Don't hesitate to contact me if you have questions.

cards.target: Nous allons prendre un taxi pour aller à la gare.
cards.english: We're going to take a taxi to the station.

cards.target: Ils avaient essayé plusieurs restaurants avant de trouver le bon.
cards.english: They had tried several restaurants before finding the right one.

cards.target: Ce serait formidable si tu pouvais venir à la fête.
cards.english: It would be great if you could come to the party.

cards.target: Essayons de trouver un compromis.
cards.english: Let's try to find a compromise.

cards.target: Protégez l'environnement, recyclez vos déchets.
cards.english: Protect the environment, recycle your waste.

cards.target: Occupons-nous de ce problème ensemble.
cards.english: Let's take care of this problem together.
